title: a2-schema Contract Module v0.1.3 — Comprehensive + JP/US Jurisdiction Coverage
description: Comprehensive contract module. Extends a2-schema Grand Vault v0.0.3 primitives via $ref. Coverage: parties & identity, structure & clauses, lifecycle states, negotiation & redlines, signing ceremony, obligations & milestones, amendments & relationships, financial primitives, risk/compliance, operational metadata. Jurisdiction coverage: Japan (民法/商法/電子署名法/個人情報保護法/下請法/独占禁止法) and United States (UCC, ESIGN/UETA, state common law, FCPA, federal/state-level). NOT a substitute for jurisdiction-specific legal review. Opinionated v0.1.0 baseline; expect iteration with real legal counsel.
$comment: Module: contract | depends_on: https://a2-schema.org/vault/v0.0.6/schema.json | sidecar: a2_contract_module_v_00_01_02.sidecar.json | jurisdictions: JP, US | license: Apache-2.0

x-history.comment: Add document-render content model: new $defs Paragraph + SubItem; Clause.paragraphs[] (clause body) and Recital.recitalText (preamble prose). Numbers (第N条 / 1 / (1)) are derived at render from array index — clauseNumber/recitalOrder remain optional explicit overrides. Add x-a2-ui numbering metadata on clauses/paragraphs/items. See docs/apps/a2-schema-editor/utilities/document_render_model.md.

Drop JPInkanRecord $def and ContractDocument.jpInkanRecords. Paper-seal records are out of scope for the digital-signature stack; 印鑑証明書 attachment is covered by Exhibit. Cryptographic signing flow uses BlockSignature / SignatoryBlock / JPDenshiShomeiCompliance.

recitalText.description: The preamble/whereas prose. May contain {{token}} references (e.g. {{parties.1.name}}, {{purpose}}).
